title: Odile and the Harvest
author: Silas Vasquez
blurb: Paloma Sterling, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
